h1.cap: Lion... or fox? Which one are you?

n3.cap: Picture Sam. Fearless. A pure lion.

n4.cap: He signs a big deal fast... and walks into a trap in the small print.

n5.cap: Maya is a pure fox. She spots every trap... but when a bully pushes, she folds.

q1.cap: Machiavelli wrote... "it is necessary to be a fox to discover the snares and a lion to terrify the wolves."

q2.cap: His fox also breaks promises... "a great pretender and dissembler."

n7.cap: Don't copy that. Understand it... so nobody plays you. Spot the trap... never set one.

n8.cap: Your action today: before you say yes to anything, ask one fox question... what's the catch? Then answer like a lion.

n9.cap: More lion, or more fox? Comment below.
